title: JWT alg-from-header accepts none / weak HMAC verification
summary: Token header alg is attacker-controlled; none algorithm and partial HMAC compare allow forged sessions.

threat_model.attacker: remote client supplying X-N / n JWT
threat_model.impact: authentication bypass via forged token and session spoof

patch_sketch: Pin allowed algorithms server-side; reject alg=none; verify full HMAC.
